title: CMCNet: Aligning Ultrasound Image Embeddings with Textual TI-RADS Representations for Fine-Grained Thyroid Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.13939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ultrasound is the primary imaging modality for assessing thyroid nodules, and the ACR TI-RADS framework standardizes diagnosis through five ultrasound feature categories that are aggregated into five risk levels (TR1-TR5). Although widely adopted in clinical practice, most deep learning approaches focus on binary malignancy classification, while multi-class prediction and explicit utilization of feature-level supervision remain underexplored, largely due to limited annotated data. translated_title: CMCNet：将超声图像嵌入与文本TI-RADS表示对齐以实现细粒度甲状腺分类
translated_abstract: 超声是评估甲状腺结节的主要影像学手段，ACR TI-RADS框架通过五个超声特征类别标准化诊断，并将这些特征汇总为五个风险级别（TR1-TR5）。尽管在临床实践中被广泛采用，但大多数深度学习方法集中于二元恶性分类，而多类别预测及对特征级监督的显式利用仍未充分探索，这主要受限于标注数据不足。在本研究中，我们引入了STN数据集，包含600个甲状腺结节，配有成对的横断面和纵断面超声图像、边界框标注以及所有五个TI-RADS特征类别的完整标签。遵循临床决策过程，我们研究了结构化特征信息如何在训练期间引导表示学习，同时在推理时仅需图像。我们证明了从标准化特征中得出的文本嵌入能够有效指导模型对齐，从而实现更精细的分类性能。
tldr: 本文提出了CMCNet方法，通过将超声图像嵌入与文本TI-RADS特征表示对齐，在仅需图像推理的情况下利用结构化特征监督，实现了细粒度甲状腺分类，并引入了带完整五类TI-RADS标注的STN数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CMCNet, which aligns ultrasound image embeddings with textual TI-RADS representations to leverage structured feature supervision during training while requiring only images at inference, achieving fine-grained thyroid classification, and introduces the STN dataset with complete five-category TI-RADS annotations.
